> A compact ESP32-based study timer with an OLED display, rotary encoder, buttons, and buzzer. It lets me select and run customizable focus sessions while displaying the remaining time and session status. This project is designed as a beginner-friendly hardware system that combines embedded programming with a practical everyday tool.
